_comment: Spec for scripts/deb-copyright.py: the DEP-5 copyright file that the .deb
and the AppImage install as /usr/share/doc/lantenna/copyright (the Flatpak,
scripts/notices.sh sets RUST_DOC and RUST_VERSION from the building toolchain.
The repository has no LICENSE yet, so 'own' makes no claim for Lantenna's code.
